common_name: Roundhead prairie clover / white prairie clover
look_here_first: Look for compact white flower globes on a low, many-stemmed, gland-dotted prairie clover with mostly 3 narrow leaflets.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays — Master Plant Pool Hays-local source. Travis — county-level Texas distribution. Williamson — UT Plant Resources Center county flora treatment.

morphology_keys.comparison_training: Compared with D. nana, D. multiflora has white rounded heads rather than yellow flowers aging rose-purple. Compared with D. tenuis, it has a compact round head and broader-looking 3(–5)-foliolate foliage rather than the feathery linear 3-foliolate look.
